adjudications.disposition: declined by the translator — adjudicated ACCEPTED (no text change warranted); residual recording task reported as an observation
adjudications.evidence: Independent recount conditioned on the English value: of the 53 EN keys that say «backend», vi keeps the English word in 33 and renders «máy chủ» in 20 — the earlier rationale's 165-vs-33 figures counted all «máy chủ» values, most of which render EN «server», so they do not measure this term. For THIS sentence the same chat window's status strip says «Không kết nối được với máy chủ Local Operator. Tin nhắn sẽ chờ gửi.» (ui.chat.status.unreachable), and the vi guide reserves «máy chủ» for the server sense including the local API server. Keeping «máy chủ» is therefore the consistent choice; the NIT's own recommendation was to keep it. What remains open is the guide record of the split, which lives in ~/local-operator/i18n/style-guides/vi.md, outside this change.

observations.text: The locale renders EN «backend» both ways (33 kept-English, 20 «máy chủ») with no rule in the vi style guide. This change needs no wording change, but the guide should record the call (proposed: «máy chủ» for the running Local Operator server in connection/status copy; kept-English «backend» for feature-capability errors and settings/registry copy) so the next wave does not flip values again.
